in_marathi.name: Jayanto
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayanto हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jayanto is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jayanta', which means 'conqueror' or 'victorious'. It is a name that signifies power, triumph, and courage. In Hindu mythology, Jayanto is the name of various gods and warriors who embodied these qualities.
